notes: Equip it for Brawling attacks at 3d6. The blanks (12 per gauntlet, 1eb each, used only on a hit), the knockback check, and the Facedown bonus are tracked by hand.

The sheet gives no damage, ROF, or hands, so it uses the core Shotgun's (5d6 slug or 3d6 shells, ROF 1, two-handed) with 5 rounds. Its Power Rebuild is not applied; install Corgo's 77 Power Rebuild if you use it.
Exotic, but it fires normal shotgun ammunition. Reloading takes 2 Actions.

Built like the core Battleglove, as Cyberleg cyberware with 2 slots, so cyberleg options can be installed in it. Equipping it takes an Action. Options in the leg it covers are not disabled automatically.
